# `azure` pack

<!-- Generated by `REDACT_BLESS=1 cargo test` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Azure tenant, subscription and identity IDs; people in Azure DevOps and Microsoft Graph records; your own Azure hosts; Azure DevOps org, project and repo names; az account details; and pipeline variable values

| Rule | Hides as | What it finds | Hidden everywhere after |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| `tenant-id` | `[TENANT-ID-…]` | A tenant GUID after tenantId, /tenants/ or --tenant |  |
| `subscription-id` | `[SUBSCRIPTION-ID-…]` | A subscription GUID after subscriptionId, /subscriptions/ or --subscription |  |
| `subscription-record-id` | `[SUBSCRIPTION-ID-…]` | The bare "id" in an az account record |  |
| `app-id` | `[APP-ID-…]` | An app or client GUID after appId or clientId |  |
| `object-id` | `[OBJECT-ID-…]` | An object or principal GUID after objectId or principalId |  |
| `identity-id` | `[IDENTITY-ID-…]` | An Azure DevOps identity GUID in an identity URL |  |
| `identity-person` | `[PERSON-…]` | A name in an Azure DevOps or Entra identity record | when it reads as a name |
| `work-item-person` | `[PERSON-…]` | The flat form: "System.AssignedTo": "Name &lt;email&gt;" | when it reads as a name |
| `dataverse-env` | `[DATAVERSE-ENV-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.crm11.dynamics.com | when it reads as a name |
| `web-app` | `[WEB-APP-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.azurewebsites.net and &lt;name&gt;.powerappsportals.com | when it reads as a name |
| `azure-resource` | `[AZURE-RESOURCE-…]` | Key Vault, storage, SQL, Service Bus and container registry names | when it reads as a name |
| `tenant-name` | `[TENANT-NAME-…]` | &lt;name&gt;.sharepoint.com and &lt;name&gt;.onmicrosoft.com | yes |
| `ado-org` | `[ORG-…]` | dev.azure.com/&lt;org&gt; | yes |
| `ado-project-url` | `[PROJECT-…]` | dev.azure.com/&lt;org&gt;/&lt;project&gt; | yes |
| `ado-repo-url` | `[REPO-…]` | .../_git/&lt;repo&gt; | when it reads as a name |
| `work-item-project` | `[PROJECT-…]` | A work item's TeamProject, and the first part of AreaPath and IterationPath | yes |
| `project-record` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The name in an az devops project record | yes |
| `repo-record` | `[REPO-…]` | The name in an az repos record | when it reads as a name |
| `tenant-display-name` | `[TENANT-NAME-…]` | tenantDisplayName: usually the organisation's own name | yes |
| `subscription-name` | `[SUBSCRIPTION-NAME-…]` | The name of a subscription in an az account record | when it reads as a name |
| `signed-in-user` | `[USER-…]` | The user or service principal az is signed in as | when it reads as a name |
| `identity-email` | `[EMAIL-…]` | The sign-in name or email in an identity record | when it reads as a name |
| `graph-user-id` | `[OBJECT-ID-…]` | The object id of a Graph user record |  |
| `graph-user-detail` | `[USER-DETAIL-…]` | Job, office and address fields of a Graph user record |  |
| `graph-company` | `[EMPLOYER-…]` | companyName: the employer | yes |
| `phone` | `[PHONE-…]` | A phone number in a Graph user record (mobilePhone, businessPhones) |  |
| `identity-guids` | `[IDENTITY-ID-…]` | A person's id, originId and directory domain in an identity record: each points at one person | when it reads as a name |
| `user-entitlement-id` | `[IDENTITY-ID-…]` | The id of a member in az devops user list: one per person | when it reads as a name |
| `pipeline-variable` | `[PIPELINE-VAR-…]` | The value of each variable in a pipeline variable group: "name": {"value": "…"}, with or without isSecret | when it reads as a name |
| `directory-alias` | `[USER-…]` | directoryAlias in an Azure DevOps user record: a short sign-in name with no @ | yes |
| `ado-org-ssh` | `[ORG-…]` | The org in an Azure Repos SSH URL: ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/&lt;org&gt;/... | yes |
| `ado-project-ssh` | `[PROJECT-…]` | The project in an Azure Repos SSH URL: ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/&lt;org&gt;/&lt;project&gt;/... | yes |

## Allowed values

These exact values are left alone even when a rule above would hide them: they are settings or public names, not secrets. Only the value itself is allowed, never what sits next to it.
